page.layout: One page of running text in one column, with marginal notes in the right margin. Printed page number 21 at the top right. Running head at the top left. Signature "C 3" and catchword "IIII. Classis" at the foot.

main_text.p: gnum Pontificem pariter perfricari: sic enim sanctus ille Pontifex:{n} Quod si Sanctorum felicitas misericordiâ acquiratur, ubi erit quod scribitur, [Reddet unicuique secundum opera ejus?] si secundum Opera, quomodo misericordia æstimatur? Sed aliud est Secundum Opera, aliud Propter Opera reddere. Hoc Romanus ille Pontifex pronunciare non potuisset, si de Meritis Operum ex Condigno vel somniasset quidem.

Hic rursus, ut omnis Amphibolia removeatur, distinguendum est de voce [Secundum,] quod nonnunquam proportionem qualitatis ex Gratia inditæ denotat, ut secundum bonitatem Operis bonitas Præmii reddatur; quod liberè concedi potest, absque ulla Relatione ad ullum Meritum. Aliquando designat (ut jam Pontificii definiverunt) proportionem Æqualitatis Justitiæ, ex Condignitate Operis, ad vitam æternam. Quam acceptionem vocis nos non rejicimus modò, sed & detestamur: In quo à Catholicis Patribus consensum testatissimum habemus; qui tum Indignitatem Operis nostri fatentur, tum etiam Supra-dignitatem vitæ cœlestis adstruunt prædicántq;. De quo infrà, Cap.10. & Cap.20. Sect.11.

page.notes: Marginal note "n" at the top right, beside the first lines of the page, reads: "Gregor. in Psal.7. Poenit. in illa verba, [Auditam fac, &c.]". Uncertain readings: "misericordiâ" (the final vowel's mark may be a macron or circumflex); "ejus?]" (the mark after "ejus" could be a question mark or colon). The opening word "gnum" is a fragment from the previous line and is kept as printed. The faint text on the right side of the page is show-through and is left out. Long s is normalised to s throughout. The "&" in the final paragraph should read "&" as printed.
